payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintain a left pointer l, iterate right index i, inner loop scans backward for earliest valid triple (s[2j-i]==s[j]==s[i]), then update answer and move l forward, achieving O(n) amortized.
payload.rationale: The nested loops with a monotonic left pointer and early break condition yield amortized linear time, characteristic of the two-pointer technique for substring counting problems.
